statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete. External fetches occasionally received HTTP 429, so the HAR is not used for byte conclusions; browser trace, Lighthouse, DOM, screenshots, and successful crawler fetches provide the judgements.

page.framework: React-like bundled SPA with server-rendered detail pages
page.notes: Public Persian classifieds marketplace. Entry and listing/detail/auth templates were sampled. Search variants and private post-auth/account/payment states were not covered because they duplicate the listing template or require a real account; no destructive contact or posting action was performed.

evidenceUsed: har (429-limited, not used for weight verdicts)

paths.description: City-selection landing page, the entry point before locality selection. Audited at desktop, 360x800, and crawler/no-JS conditions.
Tehran listings/search archetype, representing category, search, filtering, navigation, and repeated scrolling.
Representative listing detail, covering item metadata, media, seller contact actions, and crawler rendering.
Primary post-an-ad route through its phone/OTP authentication boundary, including blank submission.
robots.txt, sitemap.xml, web app manifest, response headers, cookies, service worker, and third-party surface.

findings.summary: Dark preference leaves the listings UI in its light palette
findings.evidence: A screenshot captured with prefers-color-scheme: dark remains white with the same light surfaces and grey controls as the ordinary desktop view.
findings.suggestedFix: Drive surface and content tokens from color-scheme/prefers-color-scheme (or light-dark()) and set the browser color-scheme.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe reported eight running animations, each with a 360 ms duration, while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or substantially shorten non-essential transitions inside a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce media query.

findings.summary: Route changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across the listing and detail templates found no authored view-transition-name or ::view-transition styling; navigation swaps the route abruptly.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap same-document route updates in document.startViewTransition and assign stable names to shared listing imagery and headings, with a no-transition fallback.

findings.summary: The category overlay is manually positioned rather than anchor-aware
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS places the category menu with position:absolute; top:100%; right:0; left:0 and does not use anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try fallbacks.
findings.suggestedFix: Anchor the overlay to its trigger and provide position-try fallbacks so it remains attached and visible at constrained edges.

findings.summary: Authentication overlays are duplicated custom role=dialog sections without dialog semantics
findings.evidence: The /new form probe found four SECTION elements with role=dialog, none with aria-modal or an accessible label; the visible panel is a modal authentication interruption.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one native <dialog> (or popover where non-modal), label it, set initial focus, and rely on platform close/light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: The landing page is clipped at 360 px
findings.evidence: The mobile layout primitive reported a 992 px layout/content width in a 360 px visual viewport, with 632 px horizontal overflow; the screenshot shows most navigation and content off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width and fluid/intrinsic sizing on the landing template; remove its 992 px minimum width and verify at 320-360 px.

findings.summary: Blank phone submission gives no field-level recovery guidance
findings.evidence: After activating “Next” with the phone field blank, the captured state shows no error text, and the probe reports aria-invalid=false; only a generic login-required toast remains.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, set aria-invalid, associate a specific error with aria-describedby, announce it, and keep focus on the phone field.

findings.summary: The listings path misses the good LCP range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.8 s, FCP 3.6 s, TBT 280 ms, and performance 0.67; the independent trace measured LCP 2.98 s, showing material cold-load variability.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP request chain, prioritise the actual LCP resource, reduce critical JavaScript/CSS, and validate against field p75 data.

findings.summary: Main-thread work delays interaction readiness
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks (116 ms longest) and 72.53 ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 280 ms TBT, 350 ms max potential FID, a 10.6 s TTI, and flagged forced reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Break long work into prioritized tasks, eliminate forced synchronous layout, and defer non-critical initialization.

findings.summary: Listing images lack delivery and stability hints
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 17/19 images without width/height, 13 below-fold images without lazy loading, and 14 without responsive srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image geometry, lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, add responsive sources, and explicitly prioritize only the LCP image.

findings.summary: The mobile bundle ships substantial unused code
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 584 KiB of unused JavaScript and 47 KiB of unused CSS on a 1,666 KiB transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split route and widget bundles, conditionally import maps/account features, and remove duplicate or legacy payload.

findings.summary: The login modal has no programmatic name or modal state
findings.evidence: The form probe reports four role=dialog SECTION elements with no aria-label/aria-labelledby and no aria-modal, while one is visibly presented as the login dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a labelled native dialog, expose one active modal only, and connect its visible title with aria-labelledby.

findings.summary: Mobile bottom-navigation text narrowly fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identified three bottom-nav controls at 4.39:1 (#71717a on #f4f4f5), below the 4.5:1 requirement for 12 px normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the neutral text token or lighten its surface so all bottom-nav labels reach at least 4.5:1 in every state.

findings.summary: The landing template does not reflow to a mobile viewport
findings.evidence: At 360x800 the page maintains a 992 px layout viewport and clips core city selection and navigation, preventing one-dimensional reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt a device-width viewport and responsive layout without a desktop minimum width; retest at 400% zoom and 320 CSS px.

findings.summary: Most listing images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The image audit found width and height attributes missing on 17 of 19 images, despite the document otherwise having a valid doctype and UTF-8 charset.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or an equivalent aspect ratio from image metadata for every card and trust badge.

findings.summary: Large scripts have unavailable source maps
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports one large inline/first-party script without a source map and 17 mobile bundle maps returning 403.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish deploy-matched source maps to authorized tooling or remove unreachable sourceMappingURL references.

findings.summary: The primary listing is empty to a non-JavaScript crawler
findings.evidence: The discoverability primitive fetched the listing with HTTP 200 but found 0% rendered-content coverage: raw HTML had 10 text characters, no title, H1, or description, while the browser rendered 2,226 characters and an H1.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the listing heading, introductory content, and crawlable item links; hydrate them for interaction rather than replacing an empty shell.

findings.summary: The conventional sitemap endpoint returns 404
findings.evidence: A direct fetch of /sitemap.xml returned HTTP/2 404 and robots.txt declares no Sitemap location, although canonical and robots meta signals exist on listing pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap index at a stable URL and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.summary: All observed first-party cookies omit Secure
findings.evidence: The cookie primitive found 8/8 cookies without Secure; seven are long-lived for 400 days. HSTS is present, but explicit Secure protects cookies against downgrade and non-HTTPS edge cases.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on every HTTPS cookie, review whether 400-day identifiers are necessary, and retain SameSite=Lax or stricter.

findings.summary: Browser policy headers leave avoidable gaps
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS, nosniff, DENY/frame-ancestors, and CSP, but Permissions-Policy is missing and CSP permits unsafe-inline for scripts and styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive Permissions-Policy and migrate inline script/style execution to nonces or hashes before removing unsafe-inline.

findings.summary: The listings core experience depends entirely on JavaScript
findings.evidence: The no-JS crawler view of /s/tehran contains no listing heading or cards despite an HTTP 200 response; the detail template, by contrast, provides 100% raw-content coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply the existing detail-page server-rendering approach to listing essentials, with enhancement layered on top.

findings.summary: The listing does not minimize image transfer work
findings.evidence: Although thumbnails use modern formats and are not oversized, 13 below-fold images load eagerly and 14 lack responsive source selection, increasing avoidable requests and bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media and provide size-appropriate responsive variants while preserving explicit dimensions.

findings.summary: Phone validation does not explain how to recover
findings.evidence: Activating “Next” with an empty phone field produced no inline error, no announced message, and no aria-invalid state; the user remains at the same field without actionable guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after the attempted submission, explain the required phone format next to the field, set aria-invalid, and announce the linked message.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using evidence/sitemap-headers.txt, evidence/sitemap.xml, evidence/robots.txt.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A direct fetch of /sitemap.xml returned HTTP/2 404 and robots.txt declares no Sitemap location, although canonical and robots meta signals exist on listing pages.
The listing probe found three JSON-LD blocks and ten Open Graph tags; visible title/content correspond to the listing archetype.
The cookie primitive found 8/8 cookies without Secure; seven are long-lived for 400 days. HSTS is present, but explicit Secure protects cookies against downgrade and non-HTTPS edge cases.
Tracker capture found no known tracker domains; five non-site origins were primarily Divar CDN/Sentry/map infrastructure plus one trust seal, with no third-party cookies.

checkOutcomes.method: Load-state screenshots and auth form probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt appeared on load; authentication is requested only when entering /new and uses a tel-national OTP field in context.
Headers include HSTS, nosniff, DENY/frame-ancestors, and CSP, but Permissions-Policy is missing and CSP permits unsafe-inline for scripts and styles.
The no-JS crawler view of /s/tehran contains no listing heading or cards despite an HTTP 200 response; the detail template, by contrast, provides 100% raw-content coverage.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS state inspection and route walkthrough.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered CSS includes explicit offline/back-online connection-banner states, while listing and detail routes completed without broken overlay placement.
The page is controlled by a service worker and exposes a standalone manifest with start_url, theme/background colors, RTL language metadata, and icons.
The authored connection banner has distinct offline and back-online states and the listing template includes an explicit post-list error message and load-more recovery control.
The document declares lang=fa-IR and dir=rtl; representative CSS and screenshots use RTL layout consistently.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual content review and form probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Prices, relative times, placeholders, and OTP copy are rendered in Persian conventions; the phone input uses a localized placeholder and tel-national autocomplete.
The audited marketplace surfaces show relative listing ages and no scheduled cross-time-zone event or user-entered time value to validate.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited marketplace surfaces show relative listing ages and no scheduled cross-time-zone event or user-entered time value to validate.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual review of listing, detail, and authentication states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Posting authentication states the OTP action and links terms/privacy without preselected upsells; listing and contact CTAs are plainly labelled.
Activating “Next” with an empty phone field produced no inline error, no announced message, and no aria-invalid state; the user remains at the same field without actionable guidance.
The phone input is type=tel with autocomplete=tel-national, a localized example, and an associated accessible label.
The audited account boundary clearly explains OTP delivery, exposes terms/privacy before continuation, and does not request a password or payment details out of context.
Although thumbnails use modern formats and are not oversized, 13 below-fold images load eagerly and 14 lack responsive source selection, increasing avoidable requests and bytes.
The six-second trace contained two bounded long tasks and no continuous animation/media workload; tracker capture found no known analytics tracker.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse network details, tracker capture, and screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse transferred 1,666 KiB for an image-rich marketplace feed; third-party capture was mostly Divar-operated infrastructure, with no autoplay media or known trackers.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/global capability probe and site-purpose review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No declared agent-facing workflow or WebMCP surface was found, and a public classifieds browser does not inherently require agent tool registration.
checkOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing workflow or WebMCP surface was found, and a public classifieds browser does not inherently require agent tool registration.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited core marketplace journeys do not require on-device inference; the browser API presence is not evidence of site intent.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited core marketplace journeys do not require on-device inference; the browser API presence is not evidence of site intent.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap-summary comparison after repeated scrolling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten bottom/top scroll cycles the snapshot grew 3.48 MB while additional feed content loaded, but no Detached* constructor appeared; this is bounded content growth rather than direct leak evidence.
The loaded feed used 38.3 MB heap self-size at baseline and 41.8 MB after loading more cards, proportionate to an image-rich interactive listing.
Neither heap summary exposed a Detached* constructor among retained populations after repeated scrolling, and growth was dominated by ordinary Objects/Arrays.

principleOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing workflow or WebMCP surface was found, and a public classifieds browser does not inherently require agent tool registration. The audited core marketplace journeys do not require on-device inference; the browser API presence is not evidence of site intent.
